nodes.label: Automatic DEKEL Blocker Policy
nodes.rationale: Unresolved rows, incompatible units, unconfirmed estimated quantities, and weak lexical matches remain blockers; constrained high/medium semantic selections are accepted.

nodes.label: Candidate-Constrained DEKEL Selection Policy
nodes.rationale: Codex may select only an existing DEKEL candidate, may apply high or medium confidence when units are compatible, and must leave low-confidence or invalid choices unresolved.

nodes.label: DEKEL Billing Quantity Conversion Policy
nodes.rationale: Billing quantities follow explicit catalog rules, including a 10 m³ disposal minimum and conversion of documented condensate-drain length into DEKEL points of up to four metres.

nodes.rationale: Rows without a verified code, positive quantity and positive unit price stay visible as unpriced scope but are excluded from monetary groups and totals.

nodes.label: Priced-Only BOQ Pagination
nodes.rationale: Outside edit mode, the printable monetary BOQ contains only verified priced rows while unresolved works are disclosed separately instead of appearing as zero-price lines.

nodes.label: Hebrew Matching Normalization
nodes.rationale: Common Hebrew spelling variants are normalized before token matching to reduce false misses for cleaning, lighting and power terminology.

nodes.label: Skill Execution Policy
nodes.rationale: Clarification precedes requirements and architecture; implementation may branch after approval; review, testing, and security gates block finalization.

nodes.label: Skill Governance Gates
nodes.rationale: Every stage must expose its responsible skill, produce a traceable result, and pass required review, testing, and security gates.

nodes.label: Local-to-Production Pipeline Integration Gap
nodes.rationale: Production CaseAnalysisPipeline доступен под /cases, но не подключён к /local/projects.

nodes.label: Evidence Assumption Fallback
nodes.rationale: Evidence is generated in batches of ten with up to three workers; any missing row receives an explicit low-confidence inference so scope is not silently omitted.

nodes.label: Professional BOQ Synthesis Policy
nodes.rationale: BOQ rows represent separately billable DEKEL work without artificial fragmentation, preserve compatible measurement units, exclude percentage-based management fees, and use explicit conservative assumptions where specifications are incomplete.

nodes.label: DEKEL Pricebook Governance
nodes.rationale: Фиксированный DEKEL является единственным источником кодов и цен по умолчанию; другой прайс-лист допускается только по прямой команде владельца с указанием файла.

nodes.label: DEKEL Transformation Layer
nodes.rationale: Итоговый אומדן нельзя строить прямым копированием строк DEKEL; между строками прайс-листа и выходными строками необходим отдельный слой преобразования.

nodes.label: Verified DEKEL Evidence Provenance
nodes.rationale: Every applied selection copies the catalog code, description, unit, quantity and pre-VAT price into the BOQ and adds evidence pointing to the workbook, source row and chapter.

nodes.label: Bundled Media License Review
nodes.rationale: Перед распространением MASHMAUET вместе с бинарными файлами необходимо отдельно проверить применимые лицензии.

nodes.label: Pinned SHA-256 Verification
nodes.rationale: Установщик проверяет SHA-256 каждого закреплённого файла и прекращает установку при несовпадении хэша.
